import fcntl,hashlib,json,os,select,signal,socket,stat,subprocess,sys,time,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
assert os.geteuid()==0 and socket.gethostname()=='infra-serverless'
signal.alarm(100)
folder=Path(sys.argv[1]);info=folder.lstat()
assert folder.parent==Path('/run') and folder.name.startswith('serverless-resume-invocation-request-')
assert stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and info.st_uid==0 and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o700
assert not (folder/'identity.json').is_symlink() and not (folder/'resume.py').is_symlink()
item=json.loads((folder/'identity.json').read_text());independent=len(sys.argv)>2
assert hashlib.sha256((folder/'resume.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item['resume_sha256']
lock=os.open(folder/'resume.lock',os.O_RDWR|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
info=os.fstat(lock)
assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_uid==0 and [info.st_dev,info.st_ino]==item['lock_identity']
fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
result={'event':'resumed','independent':independent,'pid':item['pid'],'container_id':item['container_id'],'image':item['image']}
if independent:
 try:fd=os.pidfd_open(item['helper_pid'])
 except ProcessLookupError:pass
 else:
  try:
   row=Path('/proc',str(item['helper_pid']),'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()
   assert row[19]==item['helper_birth'],'helper_pid_reused'
   signal.pidfd_send_signal(fd,signal.SIGKILL)
   assert select.select([fd],[],[],10)[0],'helper_death_unconfirmed'
   result['observer_killed_by_guard']=True
  except (ProcessLookupError,FileNotFoundError):pass
  finally:os.close(fd)
 result['observer_gone']=True
def inspect(name):
 return json.loads(subprocess.run(item['docker']+['inspect',name],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=20).stdout)[0]
current=inspect('serverless-api');reference=inspect('serverless-runtime-reference')
assert [current['Id'],current['Image'],current['State']['StartedAt']]==item['control'] and current['State']['Running'],'control_replaced_or_stopped'
assert [reference['Id'],reference['Image'],reference['State']['StartedAt']]==item['reference'] and reference['State']['Running'],'reference_replaced_or_stopped'
fd=os.pidfd_open(item['pid'])
try:
 assert Path('/proc',str(item['pid']),'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[19]==item['birth'],'control_pid_reused'
 assert Path('/proc',str(item['pid']),'cgroup').read_text()==item['cgroup'],'control_owner_changed'
 deadline=time.monotonic()+8
 while True:
  tracer=next(line.split(':',1)[1].strip() for line in Path('/proc',str(item['pid']),'status').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('TracerPid:'))
  if tracer=='0':break
  assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'observer_still_attached';time.sleep(.02)
 signal.pidfd_send_signal(fd,signal.SIGCONT)
finally:os.close(fd)
deadline=time.monotonic()+30
while True:
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:18090/healthz',timeout=2) as response:assert response.status==200
  current=inspect('serverless-api');reference=inspect('serverless-runtime-reference')
  assert current['State']['Health']['Status']==reference['State']['Health']['Status']=='healthy'
  break
 except (OSError,AssertionError):
  assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'control_health_not_resumed';time.sleep(.2)
assert [current['Id'],current['Image'],current['State']['StartedAt']]==item['control']
assert [reference['Id'],reference['Image'],reference['State']['StartedAt']]==item['reference']
result.update(healthy=True,reference_unchanged=True,control_start_unchanged=True,tracer_absent=True)
name='resumed-independent.json' if independent else 'resumed.json'
pending=folder/(name+'.pending');pending.write_text(json.dumps(result)+'\n');pending.replace(folder/name)
print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)

import ast,hashlib,json,runpy,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('.local/e2e');runner=runpy.run_path('e2e/execution-suite.py')
c=json.loads((b/'invocation-empty-ui-checkpoint.json').read_text());assert c['completed']
report=json.loads(Path(c['archive_report_path']).read_text());assert report['completed'] and len(report['guard_receipts'])==1
mapping={report['namespace_id']:report['function_ids']}
physical=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(runner['remote'](['python3','-B','/srv/p2enjoy-serverless/e2e/storage-console-inspect.py',json.dumps(mapping)],'root'),text=True,timeout=180));assert physical['completed']
units=[v['resumed']['unit'] for v in report['guard_receipts']]
native_program='import hashlib,json,os,re,socket,stat,subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\nassert socket.gethostname()=="infra-serverless"\nunits='+repr(units)+'\nresult=[]\n'+'''
for unit in units:
 assert re.fullmatch(r'serverless-resume-invocation-request-[0-9a-f]{32}',unit)
 folder=Path('/run')/unit;assert not folder.is_symlink() and stat.S_IMODE(folder.stat().st_mode)==0o700
 item=json.loads((folder/'identity.json').read_text());records={}
 for name in ['identity.json','resume.py','resumed.json','resumed-independent.json']:
  p=folder/name
  if p.exists():
   assert not p.is_symlink();raw=p.read_bytes();records[name]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'raw_utf8':raw.decode()}
 assert records['resume.py']['sha256']==item['resume_sha256']
 for kind in ['timer','service']:
  value=subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active',unit+'.'+kind],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
  assert value.returncode in (3,4) and value.stdout.strip() in ('inactive','unknown'),'active_resume_unit'
 try:
  fields=Path('/proc',str(item['helper_pid']),'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()
  assert fields[19]!=item['helper_birth'] or fields[0]=='Z','native_helper_still_running'
 except FileNotFoundError:pass
 assert Path('/proc',str(item['pid']),'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[19]==item['birth']
 assert Path('/proc',str(item['pid']),'cgroup').read_text()==item['cgroup']
 assert re.search(r'^TracerPid:\\s+0$',Path('/proc',str(item['pid']),'status').read_text(),re.M),'control_still_traced'
 result.append({'unit':unit,'identity':item,'records':records,'timer_and_service_inactive':True,'helper_absent':True,'control_identity_unchanged':True,'tracer_absent':True})
print(json.dumps(result))
'''
value=subprocess.run(runner['SSH']+['root@10.77.0.24','python3 -B -'],input=native_program,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=120)
guards=json.loads(value.stdout)
for native,record in zip(guards,report['guard_receipts'],strict=True):
 assert native['identity']==record['resumed']['identity']
 name='resumed-independent.json' if record['mode']=='loss' else 'resumed.json'
 raw=json.loads(native['records'][name]['raw_utf8']);expected=record['resumed']
 assert all(raw[k]==v for k,v in expected.items() if k not in ('unit','timer_state','service_state','identity','timer_stop'))
tree=ast.parse(Path('.local/collect-invocation-domain-physical.py').read_text());node=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='program' for t in n.targets));program=ast.literal_eval(node.value)
program+='\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0,"/srv/p2enjoy-serverless/e2e")\nfrom control_database import read_control\n'
program+='with read_control(Path("/srv/p2enjoy-serverless/state/control.sqlite3")) as db:\n'
program+=' assert db.execute("SELECT description FROM namespaces WHERE id=?",('+repr(report['namespace_id'])+',)).fetchone()[0]=='+repr(report['ownership_nonce'])+'\n'
program+=' assert db.execute("SELECT description FROM services WHERE id=?",('+repr(report['service_id'])+',)).fetchone()[0]=='+repr(report['ownership_nonce'])+'\n'
raw=subprocess.run(runner['SSH']+['root@10.77.0.24','python3 -B -'],input=program,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=120).stdout
installation=json.loads(raw);baseline=json.loads((b/'invocation-route-cycles-physical.json').read_text())['installation']
assert installation['services']==baseline['services'] and installation['official_sha256']==baseline['official_sha256'] and installation['agent_active']
snapshot=runner['snapshot']('.local/e2e/invocation-empty-ui.json',False,include_adapter=True);assert snapshot['source_sha256']==c['after']['source_sha256']
route=runpy.run_path('e2e/invocation-route-guard.py');folder=Path(report['route_guard_folder']);route_records={}
for name,value in report['route_records'].items():
 raw=(folder/name).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==value['sha256'] and raw.decode()==value['raw_utf8']
 route_records[name]={'sha256':value['sha256'],'raw_utf8':raw.decode()}
identity=json.loads(route_records['identity.json']['raw_utf8']);restored=json.loads(route_records['restored.json']['raw_utf8'])
assert restored['completed'] and restored['trigger']=='explicit' and not route['alive'](identity['guard'])
assert len(identity['events'])==1 and identity['events'][0]['action']=='divert-both' and identity['events'][0]['completed']
assert not report['route_mutation_unknown'] and report['route_restored']
console=route['inspect']();assert all(v['target_port']==18090 and v['tls'] for v in console.values())
assert console[route['CANONICAL']]['id']==identity['canonical_id'] and console[route['ALIAS']]['id']==identity['alias_ids'][-1]
result={'completed':True,'physical':physical,'guards':guards,'route_guard_records':route_records,'route_guard_absent':True,'route_guard_trigger':'explicit','console_routes':console,'installation':installation,'snapshot':snapshot,'namespace_count':1,'function_count':1}
(b/'invocation-empty-ui-physical.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'completed':True,'functions_purged':1,'namespaces':1,'native_helper_absent':1,'route_guard_absent':1,'control_start_unchanged':True,'routes_restored':2}))
